worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.summary: Polishes its body into a mirror and fires a thin, fast lance of light: the main target takes Steel special damage and may be left glared and less accurate; in the scatter form the light reflects off the target and splashes onto the foes behind it. Focused burns one target at longer range; scatter catches a cluster.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.use.0: Shoot down one foe's accuracy from a distance
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.use.1: Open from the open field with a fast lance of light
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.use.2: Use the scatter form to reflect the light onto the rank behind the target
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.description: The lance strikes the main target for about %1$s Steel special damage and has a %2$s chance to lower its accuracy by %3$s stage(s).
The lance reaches %1$s blocks, travels at %2$s blocks/tick and has a %3$s block beam radius.
The glare clings for %1$s: the target deals 16%% less physical attack damage, and the accuracy stages it lost stay like normal stat stages (clearing when combat lapses, not when the glare ends).

In scatter form the light reflects along the shot and spreads %2$s degrees behind the target, reaching 4.5 blocks; every other foe caught takes about %1$s refract damage and has half the glare chance to be glared (for about 70% of the duration).
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.scatter.on: Scatter: the light reflects off the target onto the foes behind, and glare lasts x1.2 with a 2-tick shorter wind-up; costs power x0.85, range -1.5 blocks, glare chance -6% and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.scatter.off: Focused: power x1.12, range +1.5 blocks and glare chance +8%, but the wind-up is 1 tick longer and there is no refract splash.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
On: the light reflects off the target and splashes onto the foes behind it (taking refract damage and half a glare chance), with glare x1.2 and a 2-tick shorter wind-up; costs power x0.85, range -1.5 blocks, glare chance -6% and cooldown +4 ticks, for hitting a cluster. Off (focused): power x1.12, range +1.5 blocks and glare chance +8%, but a 1-tick longer wind-up and no refract splash, for picking off one target.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target that is currently acting ranks higher so the light lands in its eyes mid-move; off: all targets score the same.
